The '''''Battalion''''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Praetor-class Star Battlecruiser/Legends|''Praetor''-class battlecruiser]] that operated shortly after the rise of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]].

==History==
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the ''Battalion'' was part of the [[Twelfth Army/Legends|12th Sector Army]] and functioned as [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon's]] [[Command ship/Legends|Command ship]] during the [[Sy Myrthian Insurrection]]. It destroyed the [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] ''[[Defiance's Banner]]'' at the [[Battle of Trasemene]].<ref name="EGW" />

The ''Battalion'' was later assigned to the [[Dalchon sector/Legends|Dalchon sector]] and tasked with protecting the area from [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. When the hero of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]], found himself more and more opposed to the way of the new Empire, he decided to fake his [[Death/Legends|death]] and go into [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]]. To achieve this, Tallon chose the ''Battalion'' and manned the ship with a loyal crew. Responding to a faked [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]] from a medium [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] that was supposedly attacked by pirates, Tallon entered the [[Dalchon system/Legends|Dalchon system]]. There he and his crew transferred over to the freighter, while the pirate [[pinnace]], commanded by Tallon's childhood friend [[Quist (pirate)|Quist]], destroyed the ''Battalion''.<ref name="TM" />

Later investigations would report that Tallon and his crew died as heroes, protecting the innocent from pirates. No traces of the ship or its crew were found. Tallon, officially mourned as a hero of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], and his crew lived undercover on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], while Quist continued his career as a pirate.<ref name="TM" />
